candidates.description: Craft a raw blade at the workbench. A genuinely different kind of object than a handle -- the workbench can spawn either, this is one choice among several possible objects.

spawns_followup.description: Forge the raw blade into a finished one, now that it's been crafted.

candidates.description: Craft a raw handle at the workbench. A genuinely different kind of object than a blade -- the workbench can spawn either, this is one choice among several possible objects.

spawns_followup.description: Carve the raw handle into a finished one, now that it's been crafted.

jev.instructions: A workbench can craft either a blade or a handle -- two genuinely different kinds of object, your choice. There is no objectively correct order. Once crafted, a raw piece can be finished (forged or carved).
